about.title: About Alex Pool Service
text: Let’s turn your backyard dreams into reality. Reach out to Alex Pools now to schedule a consultation with our experts. Whether you’re envisioning a new pool, a revamped patio, or upgraded pool equipment, our team is here to make it happen.

Houston’s leading pool service provider. Serving the greater Houston area! Early spring and summer are the perfect time to put in a new pool, but it’s never too late for pool service and maintenance to make sure your pool is ready for the warmer days. From pool building to pool remodeling and renovation, the team at Alex Pools Service can create the perfect pool for your backyard! We at Alex Pools Services are dedicated to providing the best pool services & pool equipment for the most affordable prices possible.
